_comment: First-party Blackout Secure actions whose hub pins are kept current
Pins stay as immutable commit SHAs so PS012 (require_pinned_actions),
Marketplace SC002 hygiene, and CodeQL actions/unpinned-tag all stay
satisfied. The bumper resolves the newest tag - ranking stable releases
and pre-releases together by SemVer - and rewrites the SHA plus its
trailing '# <tag>' comment, then opens a PR for review.
channel: auto   -> newest version wins, pre-release or not (default)
